isq.description: In-situ quantization type (for example, Q4K, Q8_0).

gguf_files.description: GGUF filenames to load in GGUF mode.

uqff_files.description: UQFF filenames or paths (mistralrs pre-quantized format). For HF repos, name only the first shard (e.g. q4k-0.uqff); remaining shards auto-discovered. Mutually exclusive with gguf_files and isq.

dtype.description: Model precision. Defaults to f32 on CPU, auto otherwise.

diffusion_loader_type.description: Diffusion model loader type. Required when pipeline is diffusion.

speech_loader_type.description: Speech model loader type. Required when pipeline is speech.

max_seq_len.description: Override auto-device-mapper max sequence length (default 4096). Lowering frees VRAM for layer placement on small GPUs.

max_image_shape.description: Override max image shape [height, width] for the multimodal planner (default [1024, 1024]). Vision pipeline only.

max_num_images.description: Override max number of images per request (default 1). Vision pipeline only.
